title: realday
description: RealDay brings a realistic day/night cycle to Minecraft, editing tick speed to match 24 hour cycles in real life.
body:
**RealDay** brings a realistic day/night cycle to Minecraft by replacing the default 20-minute day with a configurable real-time cycle. By default, one full Minecraft day lasts **24 real-world hours**, creating a more immersive survival experience while remaining lightweight and server-friendly.

### Features

* Real-time 24-hour day/night cycle
* Server-side (clients do not need the mod installed)
* Configurable day lengths
* Lightweight and optimized
* Designed for high compatibility with other Fabric mods

Perfect for long-term survival worlds, roleplay servers, and players looking for a more realistic passage of time.
